description: Turn 2 to 5 titles someone loves (films, TV, books or games, mixed is fine) into a short Taste Fingerprint™ reading — their leans on Boxlist's taste dimensions, their Taste Type and recurring themes — plus suggestions with a Boxlist match band and a reason for each. Anonymous: no account, nothing stored. Use it for "what should I watch/read/play, I like X, Y and Z".

lovedTitles.description: 2 to 5 films, shows, books or games the person loves (3 or more give a better read): names ("Succession", "Dune (2021)"), boxlist.com URLs or refs.

suggestFrom.description: Media to suggest from. Omit for all four (leaning towards the medium of the loved titles).
